characters.name: Fox
characters.notes: Includes Survey, Walk, Run animations. Good for locomotion and blending tests.

characters.name: CesiumMan
characters.notes: Includes Idle and Walk animations. Classic humanoid sample.

characters.name: Monster
characters.notes: Animated monster sample; useful for enemy behavior tests.

characters.name: RiggedSimple
characters.notes: Very small rigged figure for basic skinning tests.

characters.name: Robot Avatar (Mozilla Hubs)
characters.notes: Small CC0 avatar; many hubs avatars are CC0 and Mixamo/Y-Bot compatible.

characters.name: Ready Player Me — Masculine animations index
characters.notes: Large set of glb animation clips; useful if you want non-Mixamo combat motion from an established mocap pack.

characters.name: ToxSam — Open-source-3D-assets (index)
characters.notes: Registry of 900+ CC0 glb models (many props). Search the repo for weapons/props/environment pieces.

characters.name: MetaworldOS — Game-assets pack (props)
characters.notes: Small collections of props and pickups; check repo for direct glb downloads.

props.name: ToxSam — weapons index (search 'sword')
props.notes: Contains many small weapon glbs and prop glbs under CC0. Use repo search to find specific items.

props.name: Stylized prop pack (metaworldos)
props.notes: Props like crates, pickups, simple weapons — check the 'glb' folders in the repo.

environment.name: Khronos glTF Sample Models — Environment models
environment.notes: Many small environment models useful for prototyping: rocks, trees, simple structures.

environment.name: Quaternius Low-Poly Packs (site link)
environment.notes: Stylized low-poly characters and environment props (site-hosted). Many assets are CC0 and game-ready.

environment.name: Poly Haven Textures (external CC0)
environment.notes: High-quality CC0 PBR textures and HDRIs for skies/lighting. Not GitHub-hosted but important for look development.

audio.name: devanshutak25 — 3d-resources (SFX index)
audio.notes: Index of free SFX and audio resources; follow links for direct downloads that allow commercial use.

audio.name: madjin — awesome-cc0 (audio & assets index)
audio.notes: Curated list of CC0 assets including sounds and music.
